summary.text: Erica Roth is a Democratic Nevada Assembly member from District 24 who took office in November 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, she previously worked as a civil rights attorney and as deputy general counsel for Governor Steve Sisolak.

paragraphs.text: Roth's career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes working as a civil rights attorney and as deputy general counsel for Governor Steve Sisolak.
She assumed office on November 6, 2024, succeeding Sarah Peters.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Commerce and Labor, Judiciary, and Revenue committees.
